body.summary: Added src/db/store-guard.ts: a process-wide SharedArrayBuffer block (permit counter and health word per store, per-acquisition holder records with thread id and time), and StoreGuard with withStore (asynchronous Atomics.waitAsync wait with time limit and abort signal, release in finally, a per-thread arrival-order queue, nesting refused per async call chain via AsyncLocalStorage), policy (graph and lance direct, duckdb guarded with one permit), holders, reclaim (waits for a per-store quiescence probe, marks the store unhealthy past limitMs) and quiescence, plus installStoreGuard/getStoreGuard. Nothing calls withStore yet (t5/t6 wire the stores). Tests in src/db/__tests__/store-guard.test.ts with a real worker in helpers/store-guard-worker.ts; four falsifying mutations (no release in finally, no nesting check, timeout naming no holder, reclaim ignoring quiescence) each fail a test. Left out: cross-thread fairness beyond arrival order on each thread.
